Você é Dante. Explore, converse com os p:
You are Dante. Explore, talk to characters and follow objectives to advance the campaign.

Start by talking to Maciota. The journal lists available missions and the current mission objective. Activities around the world complement the story; you can return to them later.
Aproxime-se de pessoas, entradas e objet:
Approach people, entrances and objects and watch for the action shown on screen. It depends on where Dante is and what is nearby.

Open the map / GPS to find your way. Some routes depend on campaign progress: the route to map 2 opens only after the last mission in the first city. Mountain access is independent of that construction site.
Consulte o diário para escolher uma miss:
Check the journal to choose an available mission and read its objective. Follow the instructions; reaching the location may be just one step.

Look for activity locations around the world. Races, ski events and collectibles offer other ways to explore. The mountain also has investigations, a nighttime downhill car race and a jeep checkpoint trail.
Aproxime-se de um veículo e confira a aç:
Approach a vehicle and check the available action to enter. While driving, you can accelerate, brake, use the handbrake and control the headlights.

Visit Maciota's garage and interact to see the available services. The garage is a weapon-free area: Dante puts his weapon away on entry and can use it again after leaving.

The trunk provides access to stored items and weapons when the interaction is available.
Abra o inventário para consultar os iten:
Open the inventory to check the items and equipment Dante carries. Weapons stored in the trunk must be accessed there.

Watch the HUD indicators while exploring. Check your recovery items and available services when preparing for another mission.
Selecione uma arma, mire e dispare. Reca:
Select a weapon, aim and fire. Reload when needed and use empty hands to put your weapon away. Watch the ammo and health indicators.

Crime and confrontation can attract the police. Watch the pursuit status on screen and try to get out of danger. The surrender action lets you give yourself up when available.
No menu de pausa, abra Conquistas e Cole:
In the pause menu, open Achievements and Collectibles to see what you have found and unlocked.

Use Save game when available. Some situations, such as travel and transitions, temporarily prevent saving; the menu explains why. Before returning to the main menu, you can choose to save your progress.

The controls below reflect your settings and the device in use when you open this topic. To change keys or buttons, return to pause and open Settings → Controls.

Use the arrow keys or D-pad to navigate the guide, confirm to choose a topic and use Back to return to pause.
